text:
Type: plastic folding chair
Use: extra seating, dining; kitchen, dining room, small apartment, balcony
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glossy white plastic seat and back, chrome-plated steel frame
Colors: white, silver chrome
Shape: rounded rectangular back with a cut-out handle, flat seat, slim tubular folding legs crossing at the sides, armless, folds flat, very light and compact
Feel: practical, bright, light, casual
Goes with: white or glass tables, chrome, bright colors; small modern kitchens, studios

product.name: NISSE
product.description: You can fold the chair, so it takes less space when you're not using it.
